column3: Generated Chinese session-persistence event catalog (9142 lines): 65 root types with SHA-256 fingerprints, the SessionEventEnvelope fence, per-namespace declared event types carrying source JSDoc, then one resolved-type property table per digest. Read the header, the full fingerprint table, the envelope fence and the agent/approval/assistant/compaction/deliverables/job/llm/model/permission/plan/request/sandbox/tool/tool-workflow/turn/user/web/working-directory event fences; the remaining ~8000 lines are repetitive resolved-type property tables (sampled at 1400-1469 and 9063-9142) and were not read line by line.

Generated machine-readable companion to the persistence catalog: formatVersion 2, 65 roots (2 header, 1 envelope, 62 event) each carrying a normalized node-graph schema (object/primitive/literal nodes with optional flags) plus a SHA-256 digest, and 614 type entries keyed by digest with declaring source paths. Parsed the whole JSON to enumerate roots and types, read the head (SessionHeader graph) and the tail digest table; the ~26k lines of node graphs were not read line by line.

Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for the ACP postmortem: 11 section keys (executive-summary, summary, impact, timeline, root-cause-1, root-cause-2, why-every-test-missed-it, guardrails-added, lessons) with paired en/zh 64-bit hashes.

Postmortem 0001: an ACP namespace plugin's stray `export default apply` made the Cordis Loader's unwrapExports discard the module namespace, so the plugin fiber was built with an empty `inject` and every service read threw at load time; 178 green unit tests and 100% line coverage missed it because every test hand-built the plugin instead of loading it.
Faithful Chinese translation of postmortem 0001, same 11-section skeleton; the code fences are kept in English so the `unwrapExports` and reflect.ts excerpts stay byte-comparable with the source.
Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for postmortem 0002: 9 section keys (executive-summary, summary, impact, timeline, root-cause, guardrails-added, lessons) with paired en/zh hashes.

Postmortem 0002: `disabled: !!js ...` on a Cordis Loader entry is truthy because only `entry.options.config` is interpolated, so every filesystem plugin stayed disabled; the snapshot suite still passed because a refresh rewrote the expected outputs before any semantic assertion rejected the UNKNOWN_TOOL results.
Chinese translation of postmortem 0002, same 9 sections; keeps the `Entry._resolveConfig()` / `entry.options.disabled` distinction that is the whole root cause.
Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for postmortem 0003: 9 section keys (executive-summary, summary, impact, timeline, root-cause, guardrails-added, lessons) with paired en/zh hashes.

Postmortem 0003: a Web agent edited GUI source without knowing which URL and process hosted its session, accepted a bare-Vite HTTP 200 as success despite a missing `window.__DSH_BOOT__` white screen, and then validated a replacement `dsh web` server on another port; cites exact session-log sequence numbers as the evidence source.
Chinese translation of postmortem 0003; preserves the sequence-number citations (30939, 31865, 34309, 34441, 34681) that make the timeline checkable against the persisted event log.
Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for postmortem 0004: 9 section keys with paired en/zh hashes.

Postmortem 0004: the harness matched one case-insensitive `landlock-run: ` substring and paired it with any nonzero child exit, so ripgrep's exit 1 for no matches surfaced as SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE; introduces RunnerFailureRule with allowed exit codes, per-line fatal signatures and exact informational-line exclusions.
Chinese translation of postmortem 0004; keeps the exact `landlock-run: partial enforcement (older Landlock ABI)` notice string that the exclusion rule must match literally.
Single-section bilingual digest record for the postmortem index: one key `/post-mortems` with en/zh hashes.

Defines what a post-mortem is and is not (backward-looking failure record, not a forward-looking Agent Note) and the three admission criteria: subtle, systemic, costly to rediscover; requires an executive summary first and links the guardrails the write-up motivated.
Chinese translation of the postmortem index; the four-entry table maps each postmortem number to its bilingual filename.
Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for the vendor rescope page: 5 section keys (name-mapping, what-the-rename-does-not-touch, what-your-code-has-to-change, applying-verifying-and-reverting).

The upstream-to-published name map for the vendored Cordis stack (cordis, cosmokit, schemastery, plugin-loader, plugin-include, plugin-group, plugin-timer, plugin-hmr, plugin-logger-console) and the explicit list of what the rename must NOT touch; the mapping is owned by scripts/rescope-vendor.ts, so no reference is renamed by hand.
Chinese translation of the rescope page; reproduces the nine-row upstream/published/version mapping table verbatim, which is the artefact the rename script consumes.
Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for the session-format status page: 9 section keys (summary, table-of-contents, sources-of-truth, finalization-record, release-record, updating-the-record, dev-note).

Defines the three sources of truth for the persisted Session format (code constant SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION, an accepted finalization baseline, a verified release record) and states that a package version, codec export name, fixture filename or projection-cache version is NOT the writer authority; the release record is never lowered on trunk.

Chinese translation of the session-format status page; keeps the two fenced YAML records (latestFinalizedVersion: 4, latestReleasedVersion: 4 / evidenceTag dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2) that the bilingual doc-standard test checks for equality.

Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for the testing policy: 11 section keys (tiers, how-specs-execute, the-with-key-policy-inference-is-cheap-here, prefer-the-real-implementation-over-a-mock, verify-the-world-not-the-self-report, test-the-real-entry-path, test-resolution-source-plane-only, test-subprocess-launch-modes, when-a-snapshot-test-is-required).

The repository's test policy, tier by tier: unit, per-file-100% coverage, with-key real-API e2e, owner-local expected output, performance benchmarks, recorded-session snapshots and Web browser snapshots; states that line coverage is necessary but never sufficient, that a real-entry-path test is mandatory for product-visible plugins, and that e2e assertions must re-read the world rather than probe the agent's own output.

Chinese translation of the testing policy; the tier list and the "test the real entry path" bullets (including the `expect('default' in mod).toBe(false)` plus unwrapExports round-trip requirement) are reproduced section for section.

Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for the tool catalog: 331 lines, one key per package section and per tool (e.g. /tool-schema-catalog/deepseek-ai-dsh-tool-jobs/job-output), with paired en/zh hashes; package-level keys with identical en/zh hashes are the sections that are pure schema blocks.

Generated catalog of every model-facing tool a shipped plugin contributes to ctx.tools: the Tool Package Map (tool names → required services → events written) plus each tool's description and exact JSON-Schema parameters; the generator boots each tool plugin on a real context and a completeness guard globs packages/*/tool-* so a new tool cannot go undocumented.

Chinese translation of the tool catalog; carries the same Tool Package Map (six columns, one row per tool package) and the same per-tool JSON Schemas, with a header note that the English side is regenerated by scripts/gen-tool-catalog.ts and the Chinese side is the reviewed counterpart.
Two-key bilingual digest record for the tool-execution pipeline page (the generated Mermaid region hashes as one key, the prose as another).

The Mermaid graph of the tool execution pipeline: tools/pre-execute waterfall → monotonic guards → tools/execute waterfall (timeout, retry, metrics around dispatch) → the tool body → fs/write-intent gate → projectContent → tools/post-execute waterfall → registry outer normalization → finalizeContent → the frozen tools/result notification, with additionalContexts injected as a FIFO user/message only after the whole tool batch settles.
Chinese translation of the tool-execution pipeline page; the Mermaid node labels stay in English so the diagram is byte-comparable with the generated English source.

Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for the corner-radius standard: 9 section keys (summary, table-of-contents, scope-and-authority, select-the-radius, reuse-tokens-and-preserve-deliberate-shapes, nested-geometry-and-hover, settings-card-materials, apply-and-verify).

The unified corner-radius standard: a role-and-size driven scale (R4/R8/R12/R16/R20/R28 mapped to --dsw-radius-xs..panel), the three nested-geometry rules, the circle/capsule `corner-shape: round` pairing, and the settings-card material (0.5px hairline stroke, --dsw-alias-settings-card-fill); ends with a five-step verify procedure that admits the guard cannot judge whether a valid token is appropriate.

Chinese translation of the corner-radius standard; reproduces the six-row role/size/radius/token table and the split-button CSS snippet that puts the radius on the outer card and 0 on the flush inner buttons.
Per-heading EN/ZH digest record for the Web style reference: 5 section keys (ownership, component-rules, corner-radii-and-settings-cards, changing-the-system).

Styling ownership and component rules for the browser client packages: ui-theme owns the --dsw-* scale and the corner-shape/elevation materials, ui-primitives is the only cross-package control channel, CSS Modules plus clsx only (no Tailwind), and elevated surfaces take border:0 plus an --dsw-elevation-* shadow whose first layer is the 0.5px hairline stroke.
Chinese translation of the Web style reference; keeps the elevation/menu-surface and 0.5px-hairline rules that the ui-theme spec rejects violations of.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.1.7-rc.2 Schedule-bundle guide (/, /schedule-moves-into-the-automation-tasks-optional-bundle, /change, /migration).

Migration: the three Schedule rows leave the Web composition and an optional bundle inserts them, so id-targeted `disabled: false` patches start failing with `patch: entry schedule not found`; stored reminders stay on disk but stop being delivered.
Chinese translation of the v0.1.7-rc.2 Schedule-bundle migration, same Change/Migration structure.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.1.7-rc.2 transcript-view guide (/, /legacy-normal-work-details-display-as-detailed, /change, /migration).

Migration: the saved value `normal` now renders as `detailed` on Desktop and Web, and a missing/null/invalid value defaults to `detailed` in non-Desktop Web while Desktop keeps `standard`; the on-disk value is never rewritten, so a user who wants the old look must write `standard` explicitly.
Chinese translation of the v0.1.7-rc.2 transcript-view migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.0-rc.2 sign-in error-code guide (/, /account-sign-in-error-codes, /change, /migration).

Migration: `SignInErrorCode` gains `no-response` for a fetch that failed before returning a Response (including request timeouts), while HTTP response errors keep `network` and authorization expiry keeps `expired`; exhaustive client handlers must add the new case.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.0-rc.2 sign-in error-code migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.0-rc.2 bundled-Python-tests guide (/, /numpy-and-pandas-upstream-tests-require-a-separate-environment, /change, /migration).

Migration: the bundled NumPy and pandas distributions drop their upstream test directories, so `numpy.testing`/`pandas.testing` still work but `numpy.*.tests` imports need a separate environment kept OUTSIDE the managed runtime directory, which upgrades replace.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.0-rc.2 bundled-Python-tests migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.0-rc.2 runtime-alias guide (/, /custom-python-runtime-aliases-must-target-a-sibling-interpreter, /change, /migration).

Migration: on macOS/Linux a custom DSH_PRIMARY_RUNTIME payload's `dependencies/python/bin/python` and `python3` must be relative links to the sibling interpreter named for runtime.json's Python version; wheel builders must materialize command files because pip does not restore links, and Node `fs.cp` needs `verbatimSymlinks: true`.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.0-rc.2 runtime-alias migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.0-rc.2 invariants-removal guide (/, /runtime-invariant-plugins-are-removed, /change, /migration).

Migration: the dsh-invariants package, InvariantRegistry/Installer/Failure/Error and every `<package>/invariant` subpath are removed, and the four emitters (credentials/reference-updated, credentials/record-updated, authorization/settled, llm/adapters-updated) now contain and LOG listener failures instead of rethrowing them.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.0-rc.2 invariants-removal migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.0-rc.2 bundle-retirement guide (/, /automation-tasks-bundle-removed, /change, /migration).

Migration: the Automation-tasks bundle is deleted and loading a profile rewrites `dsh.profile.bundles` in package.json; the Web composition mounts schedule and ui-schedule while the clock row and the four schedule_* tools move to the presets (minimal declares neither).
Chinese translation of the v0.2.0-rc.2 bundle-retirement migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.0-rc.2 subpath-manifest guide (/, /subpath-plugins-read-subpath-icon-instead-of-subpath-package-json, /change, /migration).

Migration: a subpath plugin is not a package, so its title/description come only from `<subpath>/locale/*.json` meta and its image from an exported `<subpath>/icon`; the `<subpath>/package.json` export must be removed.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.0-rc.2 subpath-manifest migration; keeps the `exports`/`files` JSON snippet that replaces the subpath manifest.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 DeepSeek model-discovery guide (/, /deepseek-api-key-model-visibility, /change, /migration).

Migration: the deepseek-official route now returns an EMPTY catalog when its credential is missing, so the DeepSeek group is hidden rather than listed-and-then-failing with MISSING_CREDENTIAL; a saved selection absent from the catalog shows "Select model" without changing the stored value.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 DeepSeek model-discovery migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 desktop test-auth guide (/, /enable-test-update-policy-authentication-dialogs-locally, /change, /migration).

Migration: all test-build Feishu authentication dialogs default to disabled via `updates.allowTestAuthPopupWindow` in desktop/settings.json; with login disabled a gateway needing auth cannot produce new mandatory-update decisions, and an auth failure still retains a mandatory block already known in the same process.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 desktop test-auth migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 optional-capability guide (/, /explicit-installation-and-composition-for-optional-capabilities, /change, /migration).

Migration: installing a plugin package does not mount it — a bundle must be selected before its contributed rows can be configured, profiles disable automatic peer installation, and a patch that only enables a removed row does not insert its plugin.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 optional-capability migration; keeps the Host badge `insert:` YAML snippet.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 harness-home guide (/, /instruction-loading-resolves-one-harness-home, /change, /migration).

Migration: the agent-instructions row loses its `dshHome` config and always resolves the home through resolveDshHome() ($DSH_HOME when set and non-blank, else ~/.dsh); a leftover key stays in the row and is silently ignored, so the override must become an exported DSH_HOME.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 harness-home migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 job-id guide (/, /background-job-ids-identify-one-execution, /change, /migration).

Migration: a job id becomes `<kind>-<16 lowercase uuid hex>` and identifies one execution ACROSS registry lifetimes; the same JobId appears in live controls, job/registered and job/settled, and `executionId` is gone from lifecycle records.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 job-id migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 JSONL-persistence guide (/, /mount-jsonl-persistence-through-its-plugin, /change, /migration).

Migration: the JSONL persistence plugin exports named name/Config/apply with NO default export, so consumers must mount the module namespace; the concrete class is private and consumers annotate with the `SessionPersistence` service type instead of using `instanceof`.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 JSONL-persistence migration; keeps the `import * as JsonlSessionPersistence` replacement line.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 mock-server guide (/, /read-named-events-from-the-messages-mock-server, /change, /migration).

Migration: the LLM mock server now emits the Messages event NAME beside each SSE payload, because native SDKs need the names to process message and content-block events; scripted payloads, ordering and chunk counts are unchanged.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 mock-server migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 native-bundle guide (/, /native-subagent-bundles-include-global-tools, /change, /migration).

Migration: selecting the Claude Code or Codex bundle also registers its delegation tool as a Host GLOBAL tool visible to every preset including minimal, while keeping the package names, bundle selections, provider row ids and native authentication; the tool returns a child id and completion arrives as a logged notice to the parent.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 native-bundle migration; keeps the `tool-subagent-codex: disabled: true` row-patch example.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 New-Session guide (/, /start-a-fresh-agent-with-new-session, /change, /migration).

Migration: New Session creates a fresh Session and Agent from the CURRENT preset definition instead of reusing an existing empty Session, while openWorkspace/connectWorkspace reconnection and draft-preparation calls keep their reuse rules.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 New-Session migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 dsh-plugin CLI guide (/, /dsh-plugin-option-placement, /change, /migration).

Migration: `dsh plugin` reads --profile only BEFORE the forwarded pnpm arguments (which start at the first unrecognized token) and has its own help; -h/--help before the pnpm command prints the dsh plugin help and exits 0, after the pnpm command it is forwarded verbatim.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 dsh-plugin CLI migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 optional-resources guide (/, /download-optional-python-runtime-resources-explicitly, /change, /migration).

Migration: Python runtime wheels no longer carry the Office sidecar or the authoring environment and SDK startup never downloads them; `deepseek_harness_runtime.download_office()` and `download_primary_runtime()` are explicit, cache-reusing calls, and DSH_RESOURCE_CACHE makes the download offline-capable.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 optional-resources migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 Python PTC sandbox guide (/, /python-ptc-applies-the-shared-file-sandbox, /change, /migration).

Migration: the Python PTC runtime now REQUIRES the shared sandbox and sandboxPolicy services, applies the policy to each program, reports confinement in PtcRunResult.sandbox, and fails a restricted run with `sandbox-unavailable` rather than running unconfined; the default policy mode is read-only.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 Python PTC sandbox migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 title-adapter guide (/, /prepare-custom-title-routes, /change, /migration).

Migration: model-backed session titles prepare through ctx.llm.prepareCall(), so a composition that serves the title route only through llm/stream middleware must also register an adapter; custom adapters must list reasoning.efforts from least to greatest rather than in display order.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 title-adapter migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 title-provider guide (/, /migrate-session-title-providers, /change, /migration).

Migration: title providers register directly with ctx.sessionTitle.register({id, automatic, generate}) and own their own system instruction, framing, parsing and reasoning selection; only the shared executeSessionTitleLlm() call is common, and a tool-calls or max-tokens terminal finish must be rejected.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 title-provider migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 SSH launch guide (/, /ssh-helper-and-ptc-launch-configuration, /change, /migration).

Migration: dsh-ssh replaces top-level node/bootstrapPath/bootstrapHash with an explicit `launch` block (kind: node-script | executable) and requires SSH protocol 2; the connection's nodeExecutable/bootstrapPath getters become `ptcLaunch`, and the installed helper and its helperHash must be updated together.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 SSH launch migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 subagent-activation guide (/, /migrate-delegation-to-managed-subagent-activations, /change, /migration).

Migration: delegation is unified into managed activations — every call returns {kind:'activation', subagentId} and the final answer arrives as a parent completion notice; backgroundMode/enableRunInBackground/run_in_background and the standalone in-process-driver package are removed, and the activation receipt must be retained so dispose() can cancel that exact activation.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 subagent-activation migration; keeps the TypeScript collect() example that awaits activation.result and then activation.dispose().
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 preset-composition guide (/, /configure-subagent-composition-through-presets, /change, /migration).

Migration: `persona` and `toolFilter` are removed from the delegation tool (the config is rejected, not ignored) and are replaced by Agent Preset composition — spawn selects a preset via agentPreset, fork inherits the parent's and cannot restrict tools; there is no per-child tool-name filter any more.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 preset-composition migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 Team inbox guide (/, /agent-teams-messages-use-target-inboxes, /change, /migration).

Migration: Team messages go straight to the target Agent inbox and send_message returns only {sent:true} — no message id, no accepted/queued status; acceptance does not confirm model processing or a storage flush, failed sends are not retried, resends are not deduplicated, and the pending-message limit key is removed.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 Team inbox migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 terminal-label guide (/, /terminal-command-labels, /change, /migration).

Migration: TerminalBlockLabels now requires a `commandLine(line: number): string` formatter, so each horizontally overflowing command line gets a keyboard-focusable group with a localized accessible name; lines that fit add no Tab stop.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 terminal-label migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 tool-presentation guide (/, /select-native-or-ptc-tool-presentation, /change, /migration).

Migration: the tools mode field accepts only `native` (visible tools as direct function calls) or `ptc` (run_code plus a generated SDK); `both` is rejected, including via DSH_TOOLS_MODE=both, and different agent presets may still use different modes in one application.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 tool-presentation migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 web-listener guide (/, /web-listener-and-trust-configuration-moves-to-webstartup, /change, /migration).

Migration: the Web profile's webRuntime service and the web-runtime row's trustedHosts config are replaced by one webStartup service carrying the invocation's --trusted-host authorities, and a wildcard listener host (0.0.0.0, ::) is refused at load because binding every interface exposes the port to the network.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 web-listener migration; keeps the before/after `!!js` trustedHosts YAML snippet.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.1 working-directory guide (/, /migrate-working-directory-configuration-and-tool-presentation, /change, /migration).

Migration: the loop's built-in {{cwd}} prompt variable and the ACP/DSH-SDK subagent `cwd` config key are removed, and the Session's current execution directory becomes required user context persisted separately from Session.header.cwd; dynamic context providers are re-evaluated at request admission, after pre-step listeners and route preparation.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.1 working-directory migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 identity-watch guide (/, /explicitly-subscribe-to-account-identity-changes, /change, /migration).

Migration: DeepSeekAccount.watch(signal) no longer emits a snapshot when the cached Platform user ID first appears or changes; a plugin that refreshes getPlatformSession() must opt in with watch(signal, true), while credential and sign-in changes still notify every subscriber.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 identity-watch migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 account-model-catalog guide (/, /deepseek-account-models-come-from-the-account-listing, /change, /migration).

Migration: the account route lists models from the account's GET /models endpoint, serves a built-in catalog until the listing loads, and accepts per-model edits only through modelOverrides; a leftover `models` field stops the plugin at load with "models is no longer configurable", and a model requiring a newer harness is hidden and fails with CLIENT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 account-model-catalog migration; keeps the modelOverrides YAML snippet.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 font-size-shortcut guide (/, /desktop-font-size-shortcuts-reserve-custom-key-combinations, /change, /migration).

Migration: Desktop reserves Cmd/Ctrl + = and Cmd/Ctrl + - for text, code and terminal font sizes; conflicting custom bindings stay SAVED but no longer execute, and Settings flags them so the user can rebind or remove them.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 font-size-shortcut migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 from-default-profile guide (/, /from-default-profile-replaces-an-existing-profile, /change, /migration).

Migration: `--from-default-profile` now REPLACES an existing custom profile directory every time (deleting its package.json dependencies, node_modules and cordis.patch.yml) instead of refusing, which silently breaks a repeated `dsh rescue --from-default-profile web` in a script.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 from-default-profile migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 operator-connect guide (/, /select-interaction-participation-for-non-page-clients, /change, /migration).

Migration: non-page Connection installations default to `interactions: 'none'` — no $events, no $on(), no $stream() generation-recovery helper — while generated unary and raw stream methods keep working and browsers need no reauthentication.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 operator-connect migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 Azure-route guide (/, /azure-provider-route-rename, /change, /migration).

Migration: the pi-ai Azure provider route is renamed from `azure-openai-responses` to `azure` and now carries BOTH Responses and Chat Completions models; the Responses API identifier and the AZURE_OPENAI_* env names are unchanged, and a custom deployment name is mapped through AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME_MAP.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 Azure-route migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 pi-ai discovery guide (/, /pi-ai-model-visibility-without-a-credential, /change, /migration).

Migration: a pi-ai route that names a credential through apiKeyEnv returns an EMPTY catalog until the credential resolves (hiding the group) instead of listing models and then failing with MISSING_CREDENTIAL; a malformed key still fails discovery, and native-auth or credential-free routes keep their catalog.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 pi-ai discovery migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 install-over-installed guide (/, /installing-over-an-installed-plugin-package-is-refused-with-hmr, /change, /migration).

Migration: with HMR, installBundle over an already-installed package fails BEFORE pnpm runs with error.code 'already-installed' and changes no profile file; the upgrade path is removeBundle then installBundle, and without HMR the old pnpm-and-report-restart-required behaviour still applies.
Chinese translation of the v0.2.1-alpha.2 install-over-installed migration.
Four-key bilingual digest record for the v0.2.1-alpha.2 sdk-minimal guide (/, /sdk-minimal-image-reading-and-automatic-compaction, /change, /migration).

Migration: sdk-minimal now advertises read_image and performs automatic compaction — an EXTRA model request summarizing older history at a configurable threshold — while the full Session log stays uncompressed JSONL; images over the route budget are permanently replaced by attachment/path placeholders so the request can retry.
